MICCAI FLARE Task1 Pan-cancer Segmentation Dataset
	

This is the dataset for MICCAI26 Challenge: Pan-cancer segmentation in CT scans.
We have curated over 17,000 labeled cancer CT scans, aiming to promote the development of accurate and robust pan-cancer segmentation models in low-resource settings.
